subject: forcing image delete in existing deployment

messages.author: 084d0345d2a3706f
messages.subject: forcing image delete in existing deployment
parts:
I tried to deploy my app (after having already deployed it earlier today) to fix some issues (i basically just copied a bunch of functions right into my server.R file from external files to hopefully make it easier to deploy. but then i got the following error message:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 550116 error: Unhandled Exception: Conflict, cannot delete image f39c754b0b1346564f2f1d59b0baa6bbcc7b0a362de72d651694444b147cd030 because it is tagged in multiple repositories, use -f to force


Any ideas how to fix?  I was thinking I could  just run deployApp() again but giving the deployment a new name using the 'appName' parameter, but I wanted to report this issue any way.

thanks,
justin
